revisionRemark: As also intimated by our letter dated 14-Mar-22, we draw your attention towards the fact that these 6558 Equity shares are not beneficially held by Mr. Sanjaybhai Shrenikbhai Lalbhai though his PAN No. ABCPL6596 is used for the purpose of opening of demat account. He is just acting as deemed executor of Late Shri Harsh Hutheesingh. Therefore, these shares have neither been disclosed in any of our shareholding patterns nor any of the disclosures under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 under the category �Promoter and Promoter Group�. Since the System Driven Disclosures are tracking shares on the basis of PAN without considering beneficial ownership, these shares are wrongly included there.
